remarks: Available immediately, this beautifully furnished Westport home offers an exceptional short-term rental opportunity for up to six months. Set on a picturesque property in a convenient location, 190 North Avenue combines timeless charm with comfortable, well-appointed living spaces, making it ideal for anyone seeking a turnkey home.  Enjoy spacious sun-filled interiors, inviting gathering spaces, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Fully furnished and thoughtfully equipped, this home is ready for immediate occupancy-simply unpack and enjoy all that Westport has to offer. Just minutes from downtown, beaches, shopping, restaurants, and the train, this is a rare opportunity to experience one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities in a move-in-ready home.
